source_warning: Observed anchors are campaign counts, not annual GMs. k/g/H/T/w/x/R/C are explicit analyst assumptions informed by proxies and task fit; arithmetic estimates are not observed populations. Low/high scenarios are not proven bounds or confidence intervals.

crowdfunding_observations.scope: one hexcrawl product; not all OSE
current cumulative counter; late pledges not separated

foundry_source.most_played_definition: system of world with largest playtime per user over past year
foundry_source.scope: not global; not GM count; not hexcrawl frequency

scope.support_condition: All mandatory requirements of each chosen scenario met; usable English and Russian. Not current product forecast.
scope.ranking_basis: Reference D after explicit criterion-linked fit filter; common R/C preserve order
scope.RU_only_reason: No sourced language/geography split; do not assign international values to current RU-only reach.

synthetic_portfolio.distribution: Foundry most-played fractions hypothetically assigned to GMs

previous_illustrative_v1_0.description: Historical illustration only; superseded for absolute estimates by explicit proxy model.

proxy_formula: M=anchor*K*G (prior population scenarios retained); D=M*H*T*sum(w_j*x_ij); U=D*R*C

proxy_parameter_definitions.k: Hypothetical broader unique acquired/interested owner pool relative to one campaign, including other channels; not sum of campaigns.
proxy_parameter_definitions.g: Combined share of that hypothetical pool active as GM during the 12-month horizon.
proxy_parameter_definitions.H: Share of active GMs using hexcrawl in horizon.
proxy_parameter_definitions.R: Annual reach among suitable GMs given active outreach scenario.
proxy_parameter_definitions.C: Actual use among reached suitable GMs.
proxy_parameter_definitions.T: Share with unmet main preparation need before checking fit; common expert scenario 25/50/75%.
proxy_parameter_definitions.w: Assumed common mutually-exclusive main task shares sum to 1
proxy_parameter_definitions.x: 1/0/? from registry B/C/D; unknown assumed 0/0.5/1 by scenario

proxy_sources.limitation: legacy PF2 audience proxy; Remaster retention included in g; not unique current GMs
mixed player/GM and setting buyers; not all require new geography

restored_observation.claim: over 100000 PF2 Humble bundles in Feb 2023
restored_observation.reason: Dated Paizo press release republished and corroborating Forbes article resolve edition/date; accepted as historical proxy only.

sensitivity.warning: Counterfactuals are math tests, not re-scored rules.

overlap_warning: Do not sum rows as unique GMs. Overlap unmeasured; no arbitrary deduplication factor introduced.

previous_v1_1_results.reason: Old B conflated fit and residual need; replaced, not multiplied again.

fit_linkage.unknown_x_status: scenario assumptions about applicability, not population fractions
fit_linkage.A_block_role: scenario and H; no independent multiplier at fixed H
